title: Laghyn ruggyree as caarjyn
description: Ten short stories about birthdays, parties and friends on the Isle of Man: a birthday cake, a dance with old records, a telescope on a mountain, a camp by the beach, a garden party, a club's annual party, a friend's biography, twin sisters and two dictionaries, cooking with a physicist and a farewell party.

lessons.title: Yn laa ruggyree ec Elsie
lessons.summary: On Elsie's seventh birthday she helps her mother Dora make a big sweet cake with ripe berries; her friends come, she blows out the candles, and everyone gets a piece.
lessons.text:
Ta Elsie Kennish cummal ayns Doolish marish e moir, Dora. Jiu she yn laa ruggyree eck: t'ee shiaght bleeaney d'eash. Ta feaill beg ayns y thie jiu, as ta Dora jannoo bee millish mooar son y feaill.

Ta Elsie cooney lesh e moir. T'ee brishey shey oohyn. T'ee cur ny bleaystyn ayns cappan beg, agh ta paart jeh ny bleaystyn tuittym ayns y bee. Ta Elsie goaill ny bleaystyn magh lesh e mair.

“Shegin dou cur berrishyn er y bee millish,” ta Dora gra. Ta berrishyn jiarg gaase cooyl y thie. Ta Elsie as e moir goll magh. “Vel ad appee?” ta Elsie gra.

“Ta paart jeu appee,” ta Dora gra. “Ta berrish appee jiarg as bog. Cha nel berrish ghlass appee, as cha nel ee millish.” Ta Elsie cruinnaghey ny berrishyn appee ayns y cappan.

Ec y feaill, ta'n cloan çheet. Ta queig caarjyn ec Elsie. She Esme yn carrey share eck. Ta'n cloan cloie mooie 'sy ghrian, as eisht t'ad çheet stiagh.

Ta Dora cur shiaght cainleyn er y bee millish. Ta Elsie goaill ennal vooar, as ta ny cainleyn goll magh. Ta ny caarjyn eck gearey. “Ta ennal lajer ayd!” ta Esme gra.

Ta Dora rheynn yn bee millish, as ta peesh ec dagh paitçhey. Ta peesh ro vooar ec Elsie! T'ee gee yn peesh ooilley. Ta bee millish er e eddin as er e mair.

“Ta'n eddin ayd jiarg as bane!” ta Esme gra, as t'ee gearey.

“Ta'n bee shoh ro villish dou,” ta carrey elley gra, “agh s'mie lhiam eh.”

Ec jerrey yn laa, ta ny caarjyn goll thie. Ta Elsie soie marish e moir. “She shoh yn laa ruggyree share v'aym rieau,” t'ee gra.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Elsie shiaght bleeaney d'eash?
Ta. Ta Elsie shiaght bleeaney d'eash jiu.
Vel ny berrishyn ooilley appee?
Cha nel. Ta paart jeu appee, agh cha nel berrish ghlass appee.
Vel Elsie goaill ennal vooar?
Ta. T'ee goaill ennal vooar, as ta ny cainleyn goll magh.
Vel peesh ec dagh paitçhey?
Ta. Ta peesh ec dagh paitçhey, as ta peesh ro vooar ec Elsie.
Quoi yn carrey share ec Elsie?
She Esme yn carrey share eck.

lessons.title: Yn daunse
lessons.summary: For Simon's sixteenth birthday there is a dance at the school in Peel; his father Trevor plays old records, his sister Gemma runs the snack bar and a bubble machine, and the night is a big success.
lessons.text:
Ta Simon Kerley cummal ayns Pheeil. Jiu t'eh shey bleeaney jeig d'eash, as ta daunse echey son e laa ruggyree ayns shamyr vooar y scoill.

Ta jyskyn shenn ec ayr Simon, Trevor: jyskyn mooarey doo lesh kiaull veih'n traa v'eh aeg. Ta jeshaght echey son ny jyskyn. Ta Trevor cur y jeshaght er boayrd ayns y shamyr, as t'eh cur jysk er. Ta kiaull mie çheet magh.

“Cha nel jyskyn ec sleih aegey nish,” ta Simon gra. “Ta'n kiaull oc er yn eggey.”

“Ta'n kiaull er ny jyskyn shoh ny share,” ta Trevor gra, as t'eh gearey.

Ta shuyr Simon, Gemma, ec y barrey bee. Ta soo, ushtey as bee millish er y barrey. Ta jeshaght elley ec Gemma: jeshaght bolganyn. Tra ta'n jeshaght shoh goll, ta bolganyn beggey çheet magh, as t'ad goll seose 'syn aer.

Ec shiaght er y chlag, ta clag y dorrys bwoalley, as ta ny caarjyn çheet stiagh. Ta Trevor cur jysk noa er y jeshaght, as ta'n daunse goaill toshiaght. Ta ny caarjyn daunsey, as ta ny bolganyn tuittym orroo. T'ad gearey as daunsey reesht.

Lurg tammylt, ta ny caarjyn goll dys y barrey. T'ad gee, as eisht t'ad goll dys y daunse reesht. “She feaill vie ee!” ta caarjyn Simon gra.

Ec jeih er y chlag, ta Trevor gra dy vel y daunse ec jerrey. Ta ny caarjyn goll ersooyl, unnane as unnane. Ta'n shamyr feayn, agh ta bolgan ny ghaa foast 'syn aer.

Ta Simon as Gemma shooyl thie lesh nyn ayr. Ta'n oie feayr, agh ta'n eayst soilshaghey er y raad. “Va rah mooar ec y daunse,” ta Gemma gra.

“Va,” ta Simon gra. “As va rah mooar ec ny jyskyn shenn neesht.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel jyskyn ec Trevor?
Ta. Ta jyskyn shenn ec Trevor, lesh kiaull veih'n traa v'eh aeg.
Cre ta jeshaght Gemma jannoo?
Ta jeshaght Gemma jannoo bolganyn beggey.
Vel ny caarjyn goll ersooyl ec jeih er y chlag?
Ta. T'ad goll ersooyl, unnane as unnane.
Row rah ec y daunse?
Va. Va rah mooar ec y daunse.
Vel Simon as Gemma shooyl thie?
Ta. T'ad shooyl thie lesh nyn ayr fo'n eayst.

lessons.title: Yn fodreayrtan
lessons.summary: For Walter's fiftieth birthday his friends Fergus and Rosa give him a telescope; on a clear night they climb a mountain in the dark, set it on a steady rock and look at the moon and a planet.
lessons.text:
Ta Walter Gick cummal ayns Rhumsaa. T'eh 50 blein d'eash jiu. Ta Walter ny screeudeyr, agh she rollageydys yn red share lesh. Ta lioaryn mychione rollageydys echey 'sy thie, agh cha row fodreayrtan echey rieau.

Ta daa charrey echey, Fergus as Rosa. T'ad çheet dys y thie echey, as ta kishtey mooar oc. 'Sy kishtey, ta fodreayrtan noa. “She yn laa ruggyree ayd eh,” ta Rosa gra. “Ta fys ain dy vel rollageydys ny red mooar dhyt.”

Ta Walter gearey. “Shegin dooin goll seose er y veinn 'syn oie jiu,” t'eh gra. “Ta'n beinn ard, as cha nel soilshey y valley ayn.”

“Mannagh bee yn speyr glen, cha vod shin fakin red erbee,” ta Fergus gra.

Agh ta'n oie glen. Ta ny tree caarjyn goll seose er y veinn. Ta'n raad dorraghey, as ta creggyn er. Ta contoyrtys ayn: foddee peiagh tuittym. Ta Rosa goaill greim er laue Walter, as t'ad goll dy moal.

Er yn ayrn eaghtyragh jeh'n veinn, ta'n geay lajer as feayr. “Ta feme ec y fodreayrtan er boayl shassooagh,” ta Walter gra. “Mannagh vel eh shassooagh, cha bee jalloo mie ain.” Ta clagh vooar ayns shen. Ta Walter cur y fodreayrtan er y chlagh. T'eh shassooagh nish.

Hoshiaght, t'ad jeeaghyn er yn eayst. Ta ny sleityn as ny towlyn er yn eayst ry-akin dy baghtal. Eisht ta Fergus feddyn planaid. Ta fainney mooar mygeayrt-y-mysh. “She shoh yn red share ta mee er vakin rieau,” ta Walter gra.

Ec jerrey yn oie, t'ad goll sheese. Ta'n contoyrtys ny smoo ayns y dorraghey, as ta Walter goaill greim er y fodreayrtan echey.

Feyshtyn:
Vel fodreayrtan noa ec Walter?
Ta. Ta Fergus as Rosa cur fodreayrtan noa da son e laa ruggyree.
Vel contoyrtys er y raad?
Ta. Ta'n raad dorraghey, as ta creggyn er.
Vel y geay lajer er yn ayrn eaghtyragh jeh'n veinn?
Ta. Er yn ayrn eaghtyragh, ta'n geay lajer as feayr.
Vel y fodreayrtan shassooagh er y chlagh?
Ta. T'eh shassooagh er y chlagh vooar.
Vel ny caarjyn fakin planaid?
Ta. Ta Fergus feddyn planaid lesh fainney mooar.

lessons.title: Yn camp rish y traie
lessons.summary: For Kevin's twelfth birthday his uncle Norman takes him and his friend Bonnie camping by a beach; they swim, walk up a glen past rooks and ferns to a waterfall, keep away from poisonous berries and cook fish on the fire.
lessons.text:
Ta Kevin Curghey daa vlein jeig d'eash jiu. Son e laa ruggyree, ta Norman, braar e ayr, goaill Kevin as e charrey Bonnie dys camp rish y traie.

Ta carbyd mooar ec Norman. T'ad cur ny reddyn oc 'sy charbyd, as t'ad goll jiass. Ta'n camp ayns magher glass faggys da traie veg. T'ad cur seose y camp, as eisht ta Kevin as Bonnie roie sheese dys y traie.

“Vod shin snaue?” t'ad gra.

“Foddee shiu snaue,” ta Norman gra, “agh faggys da'n traie.”

Ta'n ushtey feer feayr, agh ta'n daa phaitçhey snaue as gearey. Lurg tammylt t'ad çheet magh, as t'ad soie er y traie 'sy ghrian.

Lurg shen, t'ad shooyl seose y glion dys eas. Ta biljyn ard 'sy ghlion, as ta trogh ayns dagh billey. Ta ny troghyn doo jannoo sheean mooar. Fo ny biljyn, ta renniagh glass, as ta duillagyn liauyr er y renniagh.

Rish y raad, ta berrishyn beggey jiarg. Ta Kevin goll dy ghoaill ad. “Shaghin ad!” ta Norman gra. “Ta nieu ayns ny berrishyn shen. My nee oo gee ad, bee çhingys ort. Shegin dooin ny berrishyn shoh y haghney.”

Ec y jerrey, t'ad roshtyn yn eas. Ta'n ushtey tuittym veih creg ard, as ta sheean mooar ec. “She eas mooar eh!” ta Bonnie gra.

T'ad goll sheese dys y camp reesht. Ta Norman cur aile er, as t'eh cur ooill er eeast. T'eh cur yn eeast er yn aile. Ta ooill er laueyn Kevin, as t'eh glenney ad 'syn ushtey. Ta ny troghyn goll thie dys ny biljyn, as ta'n grian goll sheese.

Ta ny tree jeu gee yn eeast fo ny rollageyn. “Bee mee çheet dys y camp shoh reesht,” ta Kevin gra.

Feyshtyn:
Vel carbyd mooar ec Norman?
Ta. Ta carbyd mooar ec Norman, as t'ad goll jiass ayn.
Vel ny paitçhyn snaue?
Ta. T'ad snaue faggys da'n traie.
Vel trogh ayns dagh billey?
Ta. Ta trogh ayns dagh billey 'sy ghlion.
Vel nieu ayns ny berrishyn jiarg?
Ta. Ta nieu ayns ny berrishyn shen, as shegin daue ad y haghney.
Cre ta Norman cur er yn eeast?
Ta Norman cur ooill er yn eeast.

lessons.title: Yn garey ec Vera
lessons.summary: Vera, a retired farmer, turns eighty; her friends Irene and Howard hold a party in her garden full of flowers, with her black cat and a colony of birds under the roof, and the wind blows petals onto the cake.
lessons.text:
Ta Vera Caley 80 blein d'eash jiu. Ta'n thie eck faggys da Doolish, as ta garey mooar eck. She shoh yn boayl beaghee eck rish 60 blein.

Va Vera gobbraghey ayns eirinys rish e bea. Va kirree as magheryn eck. Va ee yn chied eirinagh bwoirrinagh 'sy skeerey. Nish t'ee shenn, agh t'ee gobbraghey 'sy gharey dagh laa. “Ta eirinys aym foast,” t'ee gra, “agh ta'n thalloo aym beg nish.”

Ta daa charrey eck, Irene as Howard, reaghey feaill 'sy gharey son e laa ruggyree. T'ad cur boayrd liauyr eddyr ny blaaghyn. Ta blaaghyn er dagh çheu. “Ta thousane blaa 'sy gharey shoh,” ta Howard gra. Rish çhemmal y gharey, ta blaaghyn gorrym as buigh. Er y çhemmal elley, ta blaaghyn jiarg.

Ta kayt bwoirrinagh ec Vera. She kayt doo ee. T'ee ny lhie fo'n boayrd 'sy ghrian. Fo mullagh y thie, ta coloin ushagyn. Ta ny ushagyn çheet as goll dagh traa, as ta'n kayt jeeaghyn orroo. “Cha nel y kayt geddyn ushag erbee,” ta Vera gra. “Ta'n coloin sauçhey.”

Ta Irene ceau eaddagh noa. T'ee mennick ceau eaddagh 'sy fassan noa. “Cha nel fassan aym,” ta Vera gra, as t'ee gearey. “Ta mee ceau yn eaddagh shenn aym 'sy gharey.”

Ta Howard cur bee millish er y boayrd. Eisht ta'n geay çheet, as ta petyllyn veih ny blaaghyn tuittym er y boayrd as er y bee millish. Ta petyl jiarg er folt Vera. “Ta petyllyn er y bee millish ayd!” ta Irene gra.

“She blaaghyn y gharey ad,” ta Vera gra.

Ta ny tree caarjyn soie 'sy gharey derrey ta'n grian goll sheese.

Feyshtyn:
Va Vera gobbraghey ayns eirinys?
Va. Va Vera gobbraghey ayns eirinys rish e bea.
Vel Vera cummal 'sy thie shoh rish 60 blein?
Ta. She shoh yn boayl beaghee eck rish 60 blein.
Vel thousane blaa 'sy gharey?
Ta. Ta Howard gra dy vel thousane blaa 'sy gharey.
Vel coloin ushagyn fo mullagh y thie?
Ta. Ta coloin ushagyn fo mullagh y thie.
Vel kayt bwoirrinagh ec Vera?
Ta. Ta kayt bwoirrinagh doo ec Vera.
Vel petyllyn tuittym er y bee millish?
Ta. Ta petyllyn veih ny blaaghyn tuittym er y bee millish.

lessons.title: Yn feaill vleinoil
lessons.summary: A small football club in Peel holds its annual party, open to the public, fifty years after it was founded; the captain Keith talks about a hard season and the league win, reads the statistics, and an award goes to old Malcolm.
lessons.text:
Ta club soccer beg ayns Pheeil. Dagh blein, ec jerrey yn imbagh, ta feaill vleinoil ec y club. 'Sy vlein shoh, ta'n feaill vleinoil ny smoo na dy cadjin: va crooaght y club ayns 1975, as ta'n club 50 blein d'eash nish.

Ta'n feaill ayns shamyr vooar 'sy valley, as t'ee foshlit da'n theay. Ta ram sleih çheet: ny cloiederyn, nyn lught-thie, nyn gaarjyn, as sleih elley jeh'n theay.

Ta captan y fwirran, Keith Christory, loayrt hoshiaght. “Va'n vlein shoh ny streeu,” t'eh gra. “Va tree cloiederyn ching, as va'n emshir drogh. Agh she streeu mie v'ayn, as ren shin cosney yn leeg! She yn chied varriaght ain 'sy leeg rish 20 blein.” Ta ooilley ny sleih gearey.

Eisht ta Keith lhaih staydraa yn imbagh. “Ren shin cloie 24 keayrtyn 'sy leeg. Va 18 barriaghtyn ain. Hug shin 61 goal.” Ta'n staydraa mie. “As cre mychione y staydraa ayd hene?” ta cloieder aeg gra. “Cha dug y captan goal erbee!” Ta Keith gearey marish.

Ec jerrey yn oie, ta aundyr bronnit er Malcolm. Ta Malcolm 70 blein d'eash. V'eh ayns y chied fwirran 'sy vlein 1975, ec crooaght y club. Nish t'eh gobbraghey son y club dagh laa. Ta'n aundyr bronnit er son e obbyr rish 50 blein. Ta Malcolm gearey. “She'n club my lught-thie,” t'eh gra.

Ta ben aeg veih pabyr naight ayns y shamyr. T'ee screeu tuarastyl jeh'n feaill. Laa ny lurg shen, ta'n tuarastyl 'sy phabyr. 'Sy tuarastyl, t'ee gra dy row yn oie aalin, as dy vel y club myr lught-thie da'n theay ayns Pheeil.

Feyshtyn:
Vel feaill vleinoil ec y club?
Ta. Dagh blein, ta feaill vleinoil ec y club.
Row crooaght y club ayns 1975?
Va. Va crooaght y club ayns 1975.
Ren y fwirran cosney yn leeg?
Ren. She yn chied varriaght oc 'sy leeg rish 20 blein.
Vel y feaill foshlit da'n theay?
Ta. Ta'n feaill foshlit da'n theay.
Quoi ta'n aundyr bronnit er?
Ta'n aundyr bronnit er Malcolm son e obbyr rish 50 blein.

lessons.title: Yn beashnys
lessons.summary: Ivy writes a biography of her old friend Hector, a philosopher and peacemaker, for his ninetieth birthday; he tells her about philosophy, faith, politics and his work for a peace organisation.
lessons.text:
Ta Hector Mylcraine 90 blein d'eash 'sy vlein shoh. Ta carrey echey, Ivy, ny screeudeyr. T'ee screeu beashnys jeh Hector son e laa ruggyree.

Va Hector ny 'allsoonagh. Ren eh ynsaghey fallsoonys ec ollooscoill ayns Sostyn rish 30 blein. Ta Ivy goll dys e hie dagh Jedoonee, as t'ee goaill toshiaght er y beashnys.

“Cre'n fa ghow oo toshiaght er fallsoonys?” t'ee gra.

“Va mee aeg, as va ram feyshtyn aym,” ta Hector gra. “Va credjue lajer ec my voir, agh va barel elley aym. Va mee laccal toiggal yn seihll. Shen yn obbyr ec fallsoonagh.”

Lurg y chaggey, ren Hector gobbraghey son reagheydys cour shee. Va sleih jeh credjueyn anchasley 'sy reagheydys, veih ymmodee çheeraghyn. Va Hector sheealtagh: va shee ny smoo scanshoil da na red erbee. Ta sleih gra dy row eh yn sheealtagh share 'sy reagheydys.

“As politickaght?” ta Ivy gra.

“Va barel aym mychione politickaght,” ta Hector gra, “agh cha ren mee rieau goll ayns partee. Ta fallsoonagh jeeaghyn er politickaght veih'n çheu mooie.”

Ta lettyryn persoonagh ec Hector: lettyryn veih caarjyn er feie y theihll. T'eh cur ad da Ivy son y beashnys. “T'ad persoonagh,” t'eh gra, “agh foddee oo ymmyd y yannoo jeu.”

Er e laa ruggyree, ta Ivy cur y beashnys da Hector. T'eh lhaih y chied duillag. “Ta'n barel ayd mychione my vea ro vie,” t'eh gra, as t'eh gearey.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Ivy screeu beashnys?
Ta. T'ee screeu beashnys jeh Hector son e laa ruggyree.
Va Hector ny 'allsoonagh?
Va. Ren eh ynsaghey fallsoonys ec ollooscoill ayns Sostyn.
Ren Hector gobbraghey son reagheydys cour shee?
Ren. Va sleih jeh credjueyn anchasley 'sy reagheydys.
Ren Hector goll ayns partee?
Cha ren. Va barel echey mychione politickaght, agh cha ren eh goll ayns partee.
Vel lettyryn persoonagh ec Hector?
Ta. Ta lettyryn persoonagh echey veih caarjyn er feie y theihll.

lessons.title: Yn fockleyr
lessons.summary: Tessa, a scholar of phonology who speaks Cornish, and her twin sister Wendy share a birthday; their friend Diane gives them two dictionaries but cannot tell the twins apart.
lessons.text:
Ta Tessa Pascoe ny scoillar ec yn ollooscoill ayns Doolish. She sheeanchoryssaghtys yn obbyr eck: t'ee studeyrys sheeanyn ny Gaelg as ny Cornish. Ta Cornish ec Tessa veih tra v'ee aeg, as t'ee loayrt Gaelg nish neesht.

Ta jargaght er lheh ec Tessa. T'ee jargal clashtyn dy chooilley sheean ayns çhengey. “She shen y red smoo scanshoil ayns sheeanchoryssaghtys,” t'ee gra.

Ta shuyr eck, Wendy. Va Tessa as Wendy ruggit er yn un laa, as t'ad feer chosoylagh. Cha nod sleih Tessa y eddyrscarrey veih Wendy. Ta'n un folt as yn un eddin oc. Ta Wendy cummal ayns Sostyn, agh t'ee çheet dys Doolish son y laa ruggyree oc.

Ta carrey ec Tessa, Diane. She scoillar ee neesht. Ta Diane reaghey feaill beg son ny shuyraghyn. Ta daa ghioot eck: fockleyr Gaelg as fockleyr Cornish. “She fockleyryn jeh'n chied vrastyl ad,” t'ee gra. “Ta brastyl ard ec dagh fockle ayndoo.”

Cha nel Cornish ec Wendy, agh ta anaase mooar eck ayn. “Ta geearree aym dy ynsaghey Cornish,” t'ee gra. “Ta jargaght elley aym: ta mee jargal ynsaghey çhengaghyn dy tappee.” Ta'n fockleyr Cornish son Wendy, as ta'n fockleyr Gaelg son Tessa.

Agh cha nod Diane ad y eddyrscarrey! T'ee cur yn fockleyr Gaelg da Wendy, as yn fockleyr Cornish da Tessa. Ta ny shuyraghyn gearey. “Ta mee Tessa,” ta Tessa gra, “as ta Cornish aym hannah!”

Ta Diane gearey neesht. “Shegin dou ynsaghey eddyrscarrey shiu,” t'ee gra. Ta ny shuyraghyn caghlaa ny fockleyryn, as ta anaase ec ooilley ny caarjyn ayndoo.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Tessa ny scoillar?
Ta. Ta Tessa ny scoillar ec yn ollooscoill ayns Doolish.
Vel sleih jargal Tessa y eddyrscarrey veih Wendy?
Cha nel. Cha nod sleih Tessa y eddyrscarrey veih Wendy.
Cre ta Diane cur da ny shuyraghyn?
Ta Diane cur fockleyr Gaelg as fockleyr Cornish daue.
Vel geearree ec Wendy dy ynsaghey Cornish?
Ta. Ta anaase mooar eck ayn, as ta geearree eck dy ynsaghey eh.

lessons.title: Bee son y feaill
lessons.summary: Nadia, a theoretical physicist, helps her friend Robin cook for a party; she measures everything, explains protein, strength and balance in food, washes off bacteria, and tells him about the ions in salt.
lessons.text:
Ta Robin cummal ayns Rhumsaa. Ta feaill echey jiu son e laa ruggyree, as t'eh jannoo bee son y feaill. Ta e charrey, Nadia, cooney lesh. Ta Nadia ny 'ishigagh sheiltynagh: t'ee gobbraghey lesh earrooyn as smooinaghtyn, cha nel lesh reddyn.

“Cha mie lhiam bee çhynskylagh veih'n shapp,” ta Robin gra. “Ta mee laccal bee mie jeant ayns y thie.”

Hoshiaght, ta Nadia jeeaghyn er laueyn Robin. “Shegin dhyt ny laueyn y glenney,” t'ee gra. “Ta bacteyryn er dagh red. Cha nod oo fakin ny bacteyryn, agh t'ad ayn.”

Eisht t'ad jannoo bee lesh eeast, oohyn as feill. “Ta proteen ayns ny reddyn shoh,” ta Nadia gra. “Ta proteen cur niart da'n corp. Ta feme ec cloiederyn spoyrt er proteen son niart.”

Ta Robin cur beggan jeh dagh red ayns y bee. Cha nel towshan erbee echey. Agh ta Nadia towse dy chooilley red. “Ta towshan kiart feer scanshoil,” t'ee gra. “Ta mee gobbraghey lesh towshanyn dagh laa.”

“Shoh fishigagh sheiltynagh 'sy thie,” ta Robin gra, as t'eh gearey.

Eisht ta Robin cur sollan 'syn ushtey. “Vel fys ayd cre ta sollan?” ta Nadia gra. “Ta sollan jeant jeh daa eeane. Tra ta sollan ayns ushtey, ta ny eeaneyn goll veih'n cheilley.” Cha nel Robin toiggal mychione ny eeaneyn, agh t'eh gearey.

Ec y jerrey, ta'n bee er y boayrd. Ta cormid mie ayn: proteen, mess as arran. Cha nel bee çhynskylagh erbee er y boayrd. “Ta cormid mie feer scanshoil ayns bee,” ta Nadia gra.

Ta ny caarjyn çheet, as t'ad gee ooilley yn bee. “She bee mie eh,” t'ad gra. Ta Robin gra dy vel yn obbyr ec Nadia, as nagh vel eh hene agh y fer cooney.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Nadia ny 'ishigagh sheiltynagh?
Ta. T'ee gobbraghey lesh earrooyn as smooinaghtyn.
Cre'n fa shegin da Robin ny laueyn y glenney?
Er y fa dy vel bacteyryn er dagh red.
Vel proteen cur niart da'n corp?
Ta. Ta proteen cur niart da'n corp.
Vel towshan kiart scanshoil da Nadia?
Ta. Ta Nadia towse dy chooilley red.
Vel cormid mie ayns y bee?
Ta. Ta proteen, mess as arran ayn.

lessons.title: Feaill immeeaght
lessons.summary: Before Ian leaves to collect taxes on a small inhabited island in Scotland, his friends hold a farewell party where they play a medieval game of kingdoms, and he promises to phone them every week.
lessons.text:
Ta Ian cummal ayns Doolish, agh t'eh goll ersooyl. Ta obbyr noa echey ayns Nalbin, er ellan veg 'sy twoaie. T'eh goll dy obbraghey son y reiltys: t'eh cruinnaghey keesh. Ta'n ellan cummaltit, agh cha nel agh 300 dy leih er. Cha nel ellan elley cummaltit faggys da.

Roish yn immeeaght echey, ta e chaarjyn Morag as Lorna reaghey feaill immeeaght. T'ad çheet dys e hie 'syn oie Jesarn.

Ta gamman shenn ec Morag. She gamman mean-eashagh eh: ta reeaghyn, cashtallyn as reamyn ayn. Ta ream ec dagh cloieder. Ta ream Ian mooar, agh ta ream Lorna beg.

'Sy ghamman, ta dagh ree goaill keesh veih'n pobble echey. “Ta'n keesh trome 'sy ream ayd!” ta Lorna gra rish Ian.

“She'n obbyr aym keesh y chruinnaghey,” ta Ian gra, as t'eh gearey.

“Va keesh trome er sleih 'sy traa mean-eashagh,” ta Morag gra. “Va'n ree goaill y chooid smoo jeh'n argid oc.”

Ec jerrey yn ghamman, ta ream Lorna yn ream smoo. Ta Lorna er chosney!

Eisht t'ad soie as loayrt. “Vel thie ayd er yn ellan?” ta Morag gra.

“Ta,” ta Ian gra. “Ta thie beg aym rish y faarkey. Ta'n ellan cummaltit rish thousaneyn blein.”

“Nee oo loayrt rish dty chaarjyn er y çhellvane?” ta Lorna gra.

“Nee,” ta Ian gra. “Nee'm loayrt riu er y çhellvane dagh Jesarn. As tra vees laghyn seyrey aym, hig mee thie.”

Ec jerrey yn oie, ta ny caarjyn goll ersooyl. Laa ny lurg shen, she laa yn immeeaght. Ta Ian goll er y lhong. 'Syn oie, ta'n çhellvane echey goll: she Morag as Lorna t'ayn.

Feyshtyn:
Vel yn ellan cummaltit?
Ta. Ta'n ellan cummaltit, agh cha nel agh 300 dy leih er.
Cre ta Ian jannoo son y reiltys?
T'eh cruinnaghey keesh.
Vel y gamman mean-eashagh?
Ta. Ta reeaghyn, cashtallyn as reamyn ayn.
Quoi ta cosney yn gamman?
Ta Lorna cosney. Ta'n ream eck yn ream smoo.
Nee Ian loayrt rish e chaarjyn er y çhellvane?
Nee. T'eh loayrt roo er y çhellvane dagh Jesarn.
